description: Hand-crop data for the handgun extension (extensions/handgun). One positive label: a visible hand holds a handgun (pistol / revolver). Used by the sharp_object data scripts when WEAPON_CLASS_MAP=datasets/handgun/class_map.json. Source labels are mapped here; unmapped labels are dropped.
notes: Granada 'Pistol detection' (3000 VOC images, label 'pistol') and Sohas 'Weapons and similar handled objects' (hands holding pistol / knife / smartphone / purse 'monedero' / banknote 'billete' / card 'tarjeta'; only the pistol is positive). Zenodo Dangerous Items: 'gun' positive, knife / machete / bat images are negatives, rifle images skipped. Simuletic ATM robbery sample: 'gun'. Look-alikes (phone, remote, hair dryer, mouse...) are hard negatives here and are NOT in the handgun runtime veto (extensions/handgun/extension.py). Toy / replica guns filmed for the demo go in the self-filmed group (source 'vn' in build_dataset.py), labelled 'handgun'.
